(93)mgon mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/lus dal 'byor drin bzang rnyed dka' 'di/sngon bsod nam bsags pa ma gtogs pas/stabs legs dang ltas dbang gis

tei:div.tei:p: (93)mgon mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ lus dal 'byor drin bzang rnyed dka' 'di/ sngon bsod nam bsags pa ma gtogs pas/ stabs legs dang ltas dbang gis mi thob pas/ da snying po 'bong gsum chos la thon/ dgra mi rtag 'chi ba dang po ches/ dbang yod kun dbang med du 'chi byed dus/ las dkar nag gi bsags pa ma gtogs pa'i/ rjes 'brang su yang ma mchis na/ phan nges pa dam pa'i lha chos mjod/ mgon mi bslu bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ yid ches pas skyabs su su 'gro ba/ dus nam yang mi bslu 'dun pa ni/ blo rtse dang kha bton skyabs 'gro yis/ rang gcig pu zhi la gzhol ba'i blo/ khong byang chub lam gyi gegs yin pas/ da rang 'dod kyi bsam (94)sbyor rtog pa 'di/ phung nges pa'i grang dang 'dre ru zung*/ gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob pa'i blo/ 'di yod na gzhan pa'i dge ba ci/ dpe sa bon glung po'i 'bras bu bzhin/ yul stong nyid dang spros bral mthon po'i tshig dus snyigs ma'i sems la mi phan gyi khar/ slar sman ma zhu bas dug 'gyur bzhin/ dengs seng gi phal cher stong bas bcom/ tshe 'di phyi la phan pa'i dge ba zhig blo stong pas 'phrog la go skabs med/ rgyu dpe na da ris lus rten 'dir/ rkyen dge ba'i bshes kyis zin dus 'di/ don sgo gsum gyis 'bad pa chos la thon/ dge sdig gi blang dor la zhib rtses rgyob/ rang rgyud kyi rtog pa la gnyen po brten/ rang don gi bsam byor la dug bzhin mjems/ gzhan phan gyis sangs rgyas 'dod pa'i sems/ (95)dus nam yang med du mi rung bas/ 'di rnam mkhyen lam gyi srog rtsar zungs/ sems rang babs chos nyid rnal ma'i gshis/ blo spros pas spyad pas ci la mthong*/ sems thom mer bzhag pas ci zhig mchis/ gzhi lhun grub stong ba'i rang lugs 'di/ blo gzung 'jin bral ba'i ngang dwangs la/ sems gshis kyi rang bzhin rjen pa zhig lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyis mtshams sbyar dang*/

rgyu bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags mthus/ blo kho thag nang nas chod de mchis/ de ma yin pa'i bshad yam mjes mjes mos/ dus deng seng gi chos gzugs phal cher bslus/ mdor dril na dus dang gnas skabs su/ mi rang gi rgyud la rang nyid kyis/ rtog dpyod kyis (96)dran dang shes bzhin gyis/ blang dor gyis zhib cha thon pa la/ lam mdo sngags kyi srog rtsa 'dus par rtogs/
zla lung na rigs rgal thog nas kaḥthog mkhan ming pas gdams pa dge'o/// /
